entry.title: Notice of Supplemented Documented Petition for Federal Acknowledgment as an American Indian Tribe
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Indian Affairs Bureau. Published 2026-10-21. Comments close 2027-02-18. Docket 278A2100DD/AAKC001030/A0A501010.999900.
The Department of the Interior (Department) gives notice that the group known as the Juaneño Band of Mission Indians, Acjachemen Nation, a petitioner for Federal acknowledgment as an American Indian Tribe, has chosen to complete the petitioning process under the current version of the acknowledgment regulations and has supplemented its petition. The Juaneño Band of Mission Indians, Acjachemen Nation had been proceeding under a previous version of the regulations (as they existed prior to July 31, 2015). The Department seeks comments and evidence from the public on the supplemented petition.

entry.title: Ohkay Owingeh, New Mexico-Liquor Control Ordinance Amendment
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Indian Affairs Bureau. Published 2026-10-21. Effective 2026-10-21. Docket 278A2100DD/AAMM001010/A0A600000.000000.

entry.title: Civil Penalties Inflation Adjustments; Annual Adjustments
entry.summary:
Rule. Interior Department; Indian Affairs Bureau. Published 2026-10-20. Effective 2026-10-20. Docket 267A2100DD/AAKP3000000/A0A501010.000000.
This rule provides for annual adjustments to the level of civil monetary penalties contained in Bureau of Indian Affairs (Bureau) regulations to account for inflation under the Federal Civil Penalties Inflation Adjustment Act Improvements Act of 2015 and Office of Management and Budget (OMB) guidance.

entry.title: American Samoa Outer Continental Shelf Pacific Mineral Lease Sale 1
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Ocean Energy Management Bureau. Published 2026-10-20. Docket Docket No. BOEM-2026-0331.
The Marine Minerals Administration (MMA) will conduct an auction for lease areas offered in the American Samoa Outer Continental Shelf (OCS) Pacific Mineral Lease Sale 1 (Lease Sale PACM-1), in accordance with the Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act (OCSLA), as amended, and its implementing regulations. The Final Leasing Notice (FLN) package for this lease sale contains information essential to potential bidders, including Information to Lessees and Lease Stipulations.

entry.title: Public Land Order No. 7969; Withdrawal Revocation Calcasieu Radio Beacon Station, Calcasieu, Cameron Parish, Louisiana
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Land Management Bureau. Published 2026-08-11. Effective 2026-08-11. Docket A2407-014-004-065515, O2509-014-004-125222, LLESJ0000, LAES-106743780.
This order revokes a withdrawal created by an Executive Order dated November 22, 1875, which reserved land at the mouth of the Calcasieu River in Louisiana for lighthouse purposes. The approximately 2.97-acres identified for return to the public domain has been managed for lighthouse purposes since 1875. The public land was closed to the general land laws and location and entry under the United States mining laws. The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) has evaluated the land and determined it is suitable for return to the public domain.

entry.title: Proposed Reinstatement of Terminated Oil and Gas Lease WYW179793, Wyoming
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Land Management Bureau. Published 2026-08-06. Docket A2407-014-004-065516, #O2509-014-004-125222, LLWY920000. L57000000.FI0000. 17XL5017AR.
In accordance with the Mineral Leasing Act of 1920, as amended, the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) received a petition for reinstatement of terminated competitive oil and gas lease WYW179793 in Converse County, Wyoming. The lessee filed the petition for reinstatement on time and has met all filing requirements. No leases were issued that affect these lands. The Bureau of Land Management proposes to reinstate the lease.
